"""Verify published preparation, actual prefix bindings and current document links."""

import hashlib
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from v175_postprocess import REPO, ROOT, context, read, ref, source, write_once

plan, post = context()
preparation_path = REPO / "docs/results/v175-postprocess-preparation-v1.json"
preparation = read(preparation_path)
assert preparation["postprocess_inputs"]["contents"] == post
assert ref(preparation["postprocess_inputs"]["path"])["sha256"] == preparation["postprocess_inputs"]["sha256"]
for item in preparation["source_texts"]:
    assert Path(item["path"]).read_text() == item["text"] and ref(item["path"])["sha256"] == item["sha256"]
assert len(preparation["source_texts"]) == 18 and preparation["source_compilations"] == 17
assert post["expected_metric_rows"] == 7398 and post["expected_rounded_table_cells"] == 378
assert post["remaining_local_projection_GiB"] == 0.4 and post["original_local_projection_GiB"] == 0.2
for name, digest in plan["prior_neural_hashes"].items():
    assert ref(REPO / "src/demosaic" / name)["sha256"] == digest
baseline = read(preparation["V161_metric_audit"]["path"])
result = baseline["result"]["contents"]
assert ref(baseline["result"]["path"])["sha256"] == baseline["result"]["sha256"]
assert len(result["rows"]) == 822 and result["common_original_scalar_checks"] == 8038 and result["maximum_original_scalar_difference"] == 0
live = read(preparation["live_trace_audit"]["path"])
for key in ["training_journal_prefix", "training_event_journal_prefix"]:
    binding = live[key]
    with Path(binding["path"]).open("rb") as stream:
        assert hashlib.sha256(stream.read(binding["bytes"])).hexdigest() == binding["sha256"]
rejections = read(preparation["trace_auditor_rejection_checks"]["path"])
assert len(rejections["cases"]) == 8 and not rejections["original_rows_modified"] and not rejections["original_events_modified"]
documents = [REPO / name for name in ["README.md", "docs/index.md", "docs/current-model.md", "docs/research.md", "docs/experiments.md", "docs/fresh-noise-matching.md", "diary/2026-11-07-18-18-28-v175-comparison-audits.md"]]
links = 0
for document in documents:
    for target in re.findall(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)", document.read_text()):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):
            continue
        assert (document.parent / target.split("#")[0]).resolve().is_file(), (document, target)
        links += 1
owner = read(ROOT / "train-launch-v1.json")["owner"]
process = psutil.Process(owner["pid"])
assert process.create_time() == owner["created"] and process.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE, psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
status = read(ROOT / "train-status-v1.json")
output = REPO / "docs/results/v175-postprocess-preparation-verification-v1.json"
write_once(output, dict(status="pass-published-postprocess-sources-baseline-prefix-bindings-and-document-links",
    observed_unix_UTC=time.time(), preparation=ref(preparation_path), postprocess_inputs=ref(ROOT / "postprocess-inputs-v1.json"),
    frozen_postprocessing_sources=18, compiled_Python_sources=17, prior_neural_files_unchanged=96,
    old_V161_prediction_arrays=822, old_V161_common_scalars_exact=8038,
    shared_trace_validator_live_rows=live["continuation_rows"], corruption_rejections=8,
    journal_prefix_hashes_still_exact=True, document_links_checked=links,
    documents={str(path): ref(path) for path in documents}, training_owner=owner,
    owner_confirmed_live=True, observed_training_status=status, candidate_quality_not_yet_created=not (ROOT / "scores-v1.json").exists(),
    new_neural_forwards=0, new_sensor_noise_draws=0, source=source(__file__),
    scope="Preparation and partial execution proof while training is live. Final9000-row training,822-case endpoint quality,new RGB pixels and actual viewing are not yet complete. Source/label/baseline/old-native metadata checks do not substitute for those later checks. Owner liveness applies only to this timestamp."))
print("PASS18 frozen sources;822 old V161 arrays/8038 exact scalars;live-prefix byte hashes;", links, "links;training owner live")
